The three efforts are described in the files inside `pipeline/stages/` — one covers ADMET profiling, one covers crystallography of our lead compound, and one covers the selectivity panel.

I need you to set up a proper structured tracking system for all three of these work-items so that anyone (or any AI assistant) can instantly pick up exactly where we left off after an interruption. The crystallography effort is currently blocked and that blockage must be clearly recorded as part of its tracking entry.

Once all three are tracked, make sure the tracking system itself is validated — confirm all entries conform to the standard structure we use for this type of work-item.
